segments.text: Among the great signs of the end of the world... armies, false prophets, the sun itself... one sign is so small it hides inside an ordinary hello. And it may already have happened to you... today.
segments._shot: crowded city crosswalk from above, anonymous motion

segments.text: This is the sign... of the greeting.
segments.title: THE GREETING
segments.titleSub: the smallest sign of the Hour
segments._shot: slow bokeh of cold city lights on black

segments.text: In Islam, the greeting is not small talk. As-salamu alaykum... peace be upon you... is a prayer offered to strangers, a right owed to whoever crosses your path. The Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him, taught his companions to spread the greeting... to those you know, and those you do not.
segments._shot: warm light spilling through an old doorway

segments.text: And then he told them a day would come when that would quietly die. Among the signs of the Hour... he said... is that a man will give the greeting to another... only because he knows him.
segments._shot: two paths diverging in an empty park, autumn

segments.text: A fuller narration from the same companion... Abdullah ibn Mas'ud, may Allah be pleased with him... also judged authentic, lists what grows alongside it... trade spreading everywhere... family ties cut... and false testimony. A world that is more connected... and less warm... at the same time.
segments._shot: endless container port or lit highways at night

segments.text: Feel how precise that is. Not... people will become evil. Just... the circle of your peace will shrink to the people already inside it. Warmth rationed to acquaintances. Kindness... privatized.
segments._shot: one lit window in a dark apartment block

segments.text: This is the rare prophecy you can push back on with one sentence. Peace be upon you... said to someone who was not expecting it. The sign is that the greeting grows cold. So warm it.
segments._shot: morning light warming a quiet street
